spoken_summary: Donald Trump promises that on day one of his new administration, he will end inflation and make America affordable again because prices are too high.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Donald Trump's speech. A deep, percussive sound effect punctuates the appearance of each news headline, creating an ominous tone.
editing_pacing: The editing juxtaposes a static talking-head shot of Trump with a slideshow of news headlines that cut in sequentially on the bottom half of the screen.
central_claim: Donald Trump's promises to control inflation are hypocritical and have been proven false by his track record, as documented by various news outlets.
intended_effect: To cause viewers to distrust Donald Trump's economic promises and view him as a failure on the issue of inflation.
